title: Replace Ly with SDDM
description: Deploy a Berg-themed SDDM Wayland greeter, relocate the artwork runtime store, validate a cold boot, and retire Ly.

title: Install and validate SDDM stage one
description: Relocate artwork runtime data, deploy the Berg SDDM theme and Wayland greeter, preserve Ly as rollback, and validate before reboot.
acceptance_criteria: SDDM is configured and enabled for next boot; Ly remains installed but disabled; tty2 recovery is enabled; source tests pass.
notes: Accepted on 2026-08-16 after reboot: SDDM active/enabled and display-manager.service resolves to sddm; tty2 recovery active/enabled; Ly inactive/disabled; Berg background rendered from current.png; both greeter launches used the Hyprland Lua config without deprecated-conf or image-load errors; graphical login and logout/login both succeeded.

title: Retire Ly after successful SDDM boot
description: After cold-boot and logout acceptance, remove Ly package/configuration and the legacy home artwork store, then publish final dotfiles state.
acceptance_criteria: Ly is absent and disabled; SDDM and tty2 recovery remain healthy; legacy artwork data is removed only after checksum verification.
notes: Retirement implementation prepared after accepted SDDM boot. Ly is removed from the desired package list but protected from early explicit-package pruning; the SDDM role detects residual Ly state, verifies active/enabled SDDM and tty2, stopped/disabled Ly, artwork ownership/modes, valid JSON, valid WebP/PNG, and publisher metadata before deletion. Static tests, YAML lint, playbook syntax, production Ansible lint, and all 30 wallpaper tests pass. Awaiting publish and tagged host apply.
